title: Describe
description: What this `ersatztv-channel` binary supports, printed by `ersatztv-channel describe`.

binary.description: The binary that produced this document.

contract.description: Schema versions, output files and timing that integrators depend on.

describe_version.description:
Version of this document. Fields may be added without a bump; removing, renaming or
changing the meaning of a field bumps it.

runtime_capability.description: Probed capabilities of this machine and ffmpeg build. Always `null` for now.

schema_capability.description:
Values the channel config accepts. A value listed here may still be unavailable on this
machine or ffmpeg build.

commit.description: Full git commit hash, or `null` when the build didn't record one.

version.description: Release version, e.g. `0.2.4+x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu`, or `<version>+local` for local builds.

channel_config_schema.description:
Channel config schema version. Configs and overlays load when their `breaking` matches and
their `compatible` is not newer.

dynamic_callback_headers.description:
Headers sent on every dynamic source request. `DynamicSource` in the playout schema
defines them.

output_files.description: Files written to the channel's output folder.

playout_schema.description:
Playout schema version. Playout files load when their `breaking` matches and their
`compatible` is not newer.

segment_seconds.description: Target HLS segment length in seconds.

heartbeat.description:
Touched by the integrator while it still wants the channel; the channel stops when it goes
stale.

playlist.description: HLS media playlist for the channel.

ready.description: Created once the playlist is ready to serve.

subtitle_playlist.description: WebVTT subtitle playlist, written when subtitles are converted.

compatible.description: Compatible digit; documents with this value or lower load.

uri.description: Newest version URI this binary accepts, as written in a document's `version`.
